fields.comment: Requested reasoning effort; interpretation depends on the upstream provider.
fields.name: reasoning_effort

types.comment: Options for streamed chat-completion responses.  Mirrors OpenAI's `stream_options` request field: when `include_usage` is set, the terminal streamed chunk carries a token-usage summary.
types.name: StreamOptions

fields.comment: Observation-only billing metadata; never added to the provider wire format.
fields.name: input_token_attribution

fields.comment: Chalk's additive, effective capability profile. Upstream model objects omit this field; the router attaches it after resolving the public id.
fields.name: capabilities

fields.comment: Provider-native catalog fields retained only long enough to map authoritative discovery facts. They are never echoed by Chalk's model APIs and are never deserialized directly into the public schema.
fields.name: provider_metadata
fields.type: std :: collections :: BTreeMap < String , serde_json :: Value >

variants.comment: Model token IDs are already tokenized; preserve them unchanged.
variants.name: Tokens

variants.comment: One document combining text and image parts into a single embedding.
variants.name: Multimodal

fields.comment: `background` for the OpenAI gpt-image family ("auto"/"transparent"/ "opaque"). Forwarded as-is to OpenAI's images endpoint; ignored by providers that don't accept it.
fields.name: background

fields.comment: `output_format` for the OpenAI gpt-image family ("png"/"jpeg"/"webp").
fields.name: output_format

fields.comment: Provider-specific aspect ratio, e.g. "1:1" or "16:9". Not part of the OpenAI images API; Google's compatibility endpoint uses `size` instead.
fields.name: aspect_ratio

fields.comment: Provider-specific resolution tier. Google's OpenAI-compatible images endpoint rejects this top-level field; use `size` instead.
fields.name: image_size

fields.type: std :: collections :: BTreeMap < String , serde_json :: Value >

types.comment: A Responses request accepts either a shorthand user string or a list of fully-typed input items.
types.name: ResponseInput

types.comment: A forward-compatible Responses input or output item.  Keeping the discriminant optional also supports the API's "easy input message" shape, where `{role, content}` is accepted without `type: message`.
types.name: ResponseItem

types.comment: A forward-compatible Responses message content part.
types.name: ResponseContentPart

types.comment: Responses tools use a flat function definition rather than chat's nested `{type, function: {...}}` shape.
types.name: ResponseTool

types.comment: A completed (or incomplete/failed) Responses API object.
types.name: CreateResponseResponse

fields.comment: Images keyed by the placeholder that stands for them in `state`, `instructions`, or criteria (System One's `assets`).
fields.name: assets

fields.comment: Ingress fields the router does not interpret (OpenRouter's `provider`, `trace` and `user`; OpenAI's prompt-cache controls). Forwarded only when the upstream speaks the ingress format; see [`Self::forwards_extra_to`].
fields.name: extra

types.comment: A System One asset. Only images exist today.
types.name: DecisionAsset

fields.comment: `png`, `jpg`, `jpeg`, or `webp`; required with `data_base64`.
fields.name: format

fields.comment: Router extension for OpenAI's `input_image`: a public HTTP(S) URL. Only the OpenAI adapter can deliver it; System One providers need bytes.
fields.name: url

fields.comment: Router extension for OpenAI's `input_image.detail`; System One has no equivalent and drops it.
fields.name: detail

variants.comment: Locate something in an image: the answer is a bounding box given as fractions of the image (`top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`). TypeSafe Jev 1.14 and later only.
variants.name: Box

fields.comment: `prompt_cache_key`, `prompt_cache_options`, `safety_identifier`, and future fields: forwarded only to OpenAI itself.
fields.name: extra

fields.comment: A string or a boolean.
fields.name: value

types.comment: Explicit connection identity and upstream model, never a route alias.
types.name: RouteTarget

fields.comment: Zero or omission uses the default of 1000 milliseconds.
fields.name: timeout_ms

fields.comment: Zero or omission uses the default of 1000 milliseconds.

fields.name: fallbacks

types.name: JudgeOutcomeConfig

variants.comment: Text input and output without requiring audio or tools.
variants.name: TextOnlyChat

variants.comment: Chat requests must ask for structured output; plain conversational prompting is not a valid request shape for this model.
variants.name: StructuredOutputOnly

variants.comment: Decisions `box` questions: locating something in an image.
variants.name: DecisionBoxes

types.comment: Published embedding constraints. Missing fields are unknown, not unlimited.
types.name: EmbeddingInputLimits

fields.comment: Omitted inherits, null clears, and an object replaces the entire record.
fields.name: embedding_input

types.comment: Internal sparse facts returned by provider discovery or connection-shape detection. This is deliberately not the persisted declaration document.
types.name: CapabilityFactPatch

types.comment: Sparse facts intrinsic to a model. Protocol/interface availability is not accepted here because it belongs to the configured endpoint.
types.name: ModelCapabilityPatch

types.comment: Conservative client-specific booleans derived from the canonical profile. Client projections are outputs only; they are never persisted as capability truth or merged back into a profile.
types.name: VscodeCapabilityProjection

fields.comment: None means no confirmed streaming text-chat route.
fields.name: chat_protocol

types.comment: Nanoseconds since the unix epoch. Accepts a JSON number or a decimal string (JS callers should send strings: ns values exceed 2^53).
types.name: UnixNanos

fields.comment: Display name, e.g. "session", "turn 3", "tool: bash".
fields.name: name

fields.comment: 32-char lowercase hex W3C trace id (non-zero).
fields.name: trace_id

fields.comment: 16-char lowercase hex W3C span id (non-zero).
fields.name: span_id

fields.comment: Optional 16-char hex parent span id within the same trace.

fields.comment: Attribute map. Strings, bools, and numbers are recorded natively; arrays and objects are recorded as JSON strings.
fields.name: attributes
